question: Can causal T-day path-quality factors improve the V4.5 long-only base across regimes?

preregistration.single_factor_weight: 50% clean_mom20 within-day percentile rank + 50% factor percentile rank
preregistration.combo_weight: equal weight of clean_mom20 rank and each development-selected factor rank
preregistration.combo_selection: new factor must improve 2021-2023 CAGR by >=3pp and not worsen development MDD under BASE and CONSERVATIVE costs; choose best two by mean dev CAGR improvement
preregistration.oos_isolation: combo selection function reads 2021-2023 development metrics only; 2024-2026 never selects factors or weights

factor_definitions.DAY_RET: T day 09:35 bar open -> 14:45 bar close return (V4.3 reference)
factor_definitions.RANGE_POS: 14:45 close position inside T intraday high-low range through 14:45
factor_definitions.HIGH_HOLD: 14:45 close / intraday high through 14:45 - 1; closer to zero is better
